claim: The public fixture contains 36 cases: 12 expected-alert cases and 24 expected no-alert controls.
proves: Proves the number and expected verdict split of the published public test inputs.
does_not_prove: Does not prove that my detector passed the cases, that hidden cases pass, or that all twelve matrix techniques have raw replay evidence.
alternative_considered: A manual count could accidentally mix expected-alert and expected-no-alert cases.
disposition: I retained the claim because my fixture validator independently counted 36 valid fixtures with 12 alert and 24 no-alert expectations.
